Robert Half is currently recruiting a Business Analyst (M/V/X) - Region Antwerp.

Our client is an international organization undergoing a major ERP transformation across several European entities.

In this role, you will contribute to the migration from Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Dynamics 365 Business Central, helping to deliver scalable, standardized, and future-oriented solutions across finance and supply chain operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Business Analyst (M/V/X) include:

• You analyze current business processes and translate business needs into functional solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You gather and document requirements across finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, warehouse, and supply chain activities.
• You perform fit-gap analyses and align business requirements with standard Business Central functionalities.
• You configure and validate Business Central solutions, including functional setup and master data support.
• You prepare functional documentation, process flows, user stories, and test scenarios.
• You lead user acceptance testing and coordinate issue resolution with development teams.
• You support data migration, go-live activities, and post-implementation follow-up.
• You act as the key point of contact between business users and technical teams.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or ERP Functional Consultant.
• You bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You have solid experience across both finance and supply chain domains.
• You have strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, inventory management, warehouse management, and reporting processes.
• You are familiar with manufacturing, production, distribution, or other supply chain-driven environments.
• You are comfortable leading workshops, gathering requirements, and coordinating testing activities.
• You combine strong analytical thinking with excellent stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in French and English.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have knowledge of APIs, OData, Power BI, or Power Platform, which is a plus.
• You hold a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central certification, or this is considered an advantage.

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

 

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

 

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• Ideally, you have around 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in an accounting department. Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.
• You are confident using SAP and MS Office.
• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.
 

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
 
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
 
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment. 

 
• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
 
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a versatile and reliable partner in the metalworking industry.

The company offers a wide range of subcontracting services, including sheet metal and tube processing, turning and milling, welding, and wet painting.

Experienced in welding steel, stainless steel and aluminium? A stable and growing company is looking for a welder who can independently weld complex mechanical subassemblies and large chassis structures for agricultural vehicles. The position offers a modern working environment, guidance from experienced colleagues and a good work-life balance, with the working day ending at 4:15 p.m. and at 3 p.m. on Fridays.

 
• 
Independently weld complex mechanical subassemblies and large chassis structures for agricultural vehicles.

 
• 
Assemble and weld components on a welding table without a pre-prepared jig.

 
• 
Assess the quality of welded components and measure them accurately.

 
• 
Experience in welding steel, stainless steel and aluminium is essential.

 
• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings comes naturally to you.

 
• 
Knowledge of welding symbols is useful for carrying out welding tasks correctly.

 
• 
A precise and stress-resistant approach to work is important.

 
• 
A basic knowledge of Dutch, French or English is required.

 
• 
A day-shift position suits your expectations.

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key responsibilities

• 
Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design

• 
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

• 
Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

• 
Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams

Join Magnax as a Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators. You'll translate demanding motion requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs.
 
 

• Design mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept to production. 

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying industry standards and GD&T. 

• Perform mechanical calculations and design verification for performance, reliability, and durability. 

• Work with suppliers and subcontractors on components, processes, tolerances, materials, and specs. 

• Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and design improvements. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements.
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Magnax is looking for an experienced Electromagnetic Simulations Engineer to join our growing team. You’ll own the electromagnetic simulations of our axial flux motors and inverters.
 

What you’ll do:
 
 

• Develop and run electromagnetic simulations for our motors and inverters 

• Analyse results to assess performance and spot improvements 

• Refine simulation methods to shorten development time and improve correlation with test data 

• Work with simulation, mechanical and prototyping engineers to optimise motor design 

• Carry out root cause analysis on products and processes.
For a full description of the job description, please visit our careers page: https://traxial.com/careers 

 
 
 

• Master’s in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience 

• 2+ years of hands-on electromagnetic simulation experience 

• Proficient in Ansys Maxwell, JMAG, Altair (or similar) and Python 

• Basic knowledge of mechanics, NVH and thermodynamics 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 

• Fluent English and a collaborative team player

Magnax builds next-generation electric motors based on yokeless axial flux technology. They are compact, light and efficient, which makes them a strong match for robotics. We're a team of about 30 people in Kortrijk, mostly engineers from many countries. We work in English and move fast from idea to prototype.
 

As Applications Engineer, you are the technical link between our customers, the market and our R&D team.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Act as first technical contact for customer inquiries and find out what they really need. 

• Translate customer specs (RFIs/RFQs) into motor requirements with R&D, and select the right motor solution. 

• Build proposals, including pricing, and follow up until the project is won. 

• Track the robotics market and identify where axial flux motors bring the most value. 

• Report insights to management to guide product and commercial choices. 

• Support datasheets and sales tools, share customer feedback with R&D, and join customer visits and trade fairs. For a more detailed description of the job requirements, please visit our careers page: www.traxial.com/careers 

Who we’re looking for
 
 

• Master’s in electromechanical, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering 

• At least 2 years in robotics (actuators, cobots, industrial robots, humanoids, AMRs) 

• Solid knowledge of electric drive systems: motors, gearboxes, controllers 

• Strong with customers: you ask the right questions and write clear proposals 

• Analytical: you turn market information into actionable insights 

• Independent, with ownership of technical solutions 

• Fluent English; other languages are a plus 

• Open to occasional travel  

You report to the Belgian management team.

Are you passionate about global brands and eager to support their development across international markets? Join our team as Global Brand Packaging Specialist, where your organizational skills and project management expertise will be key to driving our brands’ success internationally. 
 

Over de functie:
 
 

• You’ll lead complex, multi-language packaging projects to support the introduction of new products and packaging formats into international markets. 

• For each project you oversee the project lifecyle, from concept to launch, and manage the different process steps. You collect the necessary data and translations from internal stakeholders, guide the conversion of design concepts into artwork, ensure readiness for print and adherence to market regulations. 

• In this role you’ll work closely with various internal teams (Sales & Marketing, Production, Quality, R&D, …) and external stakeholders. Through solid project management skills and a strong working relationship with all stakeholders, we count on you to maintain all projects to the required timelines and keep all parties engaged on the right track. 

• You will join our Natural Foods Global Brand team at our HQ in Lembeke, with brands such as Nakd, Trek, BEAR and Kiddylicious. 

About you
 
 

• You have a Master degree in a relevant field. 

• Whether you’ve gained a first experience or are freshly graduated and ready to launch your career in project management – we’re excited to meet you! 

• Good project management skills with the ability to multi-task and prioritize in view of business needs. 

• You thrive on detail-oriented work and have a strong commitment to accuracy and delivering results. 

• Adaptable to change and cultural differences, with a multicultural flexibility suited for an international role in a growing organization. 

• Strong communication skills in English, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration with numerous stakeholders. 

• And a personality which is in line with our TOP values – Team work, Open dialogue and Passion.

As Business Controller, you will act as a trusted business partner within our Biscuits & Bakery business unit, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to drive profitability, operational excellence, and sustainable growth across our international operations. 
 

About the job
 
 

• Analyze business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency. 

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Operations teams to deliver clear commercial and operational analyses that support strategic decision-making. 

• Drive the monthly management reporting, ensuring the accuracy of financial results, KPIs, and performance insights across the business unit. 

• Play a key role in the annual budgeting and transfer pricing processes by challenging assumptions, validating business cases, and monitoring financial impact of investments. 

• Evaluate and support strategic initiatives such as CAPEX investments, new product launches, and cost-saving projects through thorough financial analysis. 

• You report directly to the Finance Director Biscuits & Bakery. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or a related field. 

• At least 5 years of experience in Finance, Business Controlling, or a similar analytical role. 

• Advanced Excel skills, experience with SAP is considered a strong asset. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships, influence decision-making, and challenge stakeholders constructively. 

• Fluency in English, with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for a wide range of business stakeholders.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.
